 "rationale": "At 1.8 V the StrongARM has enough headroom: Vth_n 0.65 + Vth_p 1.0 stack fits, and it draws no static current. The input pair uses gm/Id ~12, L=0.15, ~5 um per side, which gives regeneration gain >10 before latching. Latch devices are short and small, so internal node C stays near 15 fF and tau is ~25 ps, giving delay ~0.12 ns. Total switched C is ~80 fF + 2*CL, so energy is ~250 fJ, below 390 fJ."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (12.0, 6.0, 18.0),      # input pair inversion level
    "I_in":    (120e-6, 30e-6, 400e-6), # per-side initial integration current (sizing current)
    "Wtail":   (6.0, 1.0, 20.0),        # clocked tail switch width [um]
    "Wln":     (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),        # latch NMOS width
    "Wlp":     (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),        # latch PMOS width
    "Wrst":    (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),       # reset PMOS width
    "Winv":    (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),        # output inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Lmin = 0.15

    # input pair sized from intent (gm/Id, L, current) at reduced Vds during integration
    mi = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], Lmin, p["I_in"], vds=0.4)
    mln = lut.op("n", p["Wln"], Lmin, 0.9, 0.9)
    mlp = lut.op("p", p["Wlp"], Lmin, 0.9, 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wtail"], Lmin)
    # input pair: vinp device drives node fa (under latch node xa)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", mi)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "xa", "xb", "fa", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], Lmin)
    n.M("M4", "xb", "xa", "fb", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], Lmin)
    n.M("M5", "xa", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], Lmin)
    n.M("M6", "xb", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], Lmin)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    for nm, nd in (("R1", "xa"), ("R2", "xb"), ("R3", "fa"), ("R4", "fb")):
        n.M("M" + nm, nd, "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], Lmin)
    # output inverters: xa falls when vinp>vinn -> outp rises
    Wi = p["Winv"]
    n.M("MI1", "outp", "xa", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, Lmin)
    n.M("MI2", "outp", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, Lmin)
    n.M("MI3", "outn", "xb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, Lmin)
    n.M("MI4", "outn", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, Lmin)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox_w = 1.6e-15  # ~F/um gate+overlap cap at L=0.15 (approx)
    Cx = (p["Wln"] + p["Wlp"]) * cox_w * 1.5 + 3 * Wi * cox_w + p["Wrst"] * 0.8e-15 + 2e-15
    Cf = mi.cdd + p["Wln"] * 0.8e-15 + p["Wrst"] * 0.8e-15
    gm_l = max(mln["gm"] + mlp["gm"], 1e-5)
    tau = Cx / gm_l
    # integration phase: discharge internal nodes by ~Vthp at ~2*I_in
    t_int = (Cx + Cf) * 0.9 / (2 * p["I_in"])
    Av = max(mi.gm * t_int / Cx, 1.0)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / (2 * Av * dv), 2.0))
    t_inv = 0.7 * (cl + 2e-15) / (lut.op("p", 2 * Wi, Lmin, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"] / 0.9 + 1e-9) + 10e-12
    delay = 15e-12 + t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    Csw = 2 * (Cx + Cf) + mi.cgg * 0 + p["Wtail"] * cox_w * 1.0 + 4 * p["Wrst"] * cox_w + 2 * cl + 6 * Wi * cox_w * 0.5
    energy = Csw * VDD ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
